meta.title: Congestion Tax Exemption (illustrative demo)
meta.description: Simplified, illustrative example loosely modeled on Sweden's congestion tax (trängselskatt). Not verified legal advice or a complete rule set — for testing this prototype only.

Q1.question: Is the vehicle an emergency vehicle?
Q1.supportiveText: Emergency vehicles are exempt from congestion tax.

Q2.question: Is the vehicle fully electric?
Q2.supportiveText: Fully electric vehicles are exempt in this simplified model.

Q3.question: Is it a weekend or public holiday?
Q3.supportiveText: No congestion tax applies on weekends or public holidays.

Q4.question: 6:00 or later?
Q4.supportiveText: Congestion tax only applies during charged hours (6:00-18:00 in this simplified model).

Q5.question: 18:00 or earlier?
Q5.supportiveText: Outside the 6:00-18:00 window, no congestion tax applies in this simplified model.

OUT_Exempt.label: Exempt from congestion tax
OUT_Exempt.description: No congestion tax applies under these facts (simplified model).

OUT_Taxable.label: Congestion tax applies
OUT_Taxable.description: Congestion tax applies under these facts (simplified model).
